snippet.title: 🔴 DW Noticias 12 de noviembre: Jensen Huang declarará ante el Congreso estadounidense
snippet.description:
El cofundador del gigante tecnológico estadounidense Nvidia, Jensen Huang, acudirá al Congreso de Estados Unidos a declarar en una comparecencia a puerta cerrada sobre amenazas para la seguridad nacional después de haber dimitido este jueves a causa del supuesto caso de espionaje en el que se ha visto envuelto. 

El presidente del Comité de Asuntos Exteriores de la Cámara de Representantes, Brian Mast, aseguró este jueves a medios estadounidenses que Huang ha aceptado la comparecencia y que es posible que acuda al Capitolio la próxima semana.

La dimisión de Huang llegó este jueves después de días de informaciones sobre sus infidelidades, la primera con una presunta espía china, Alice Huang, y la segunda con una subordinada, alto cargo en Nvidia.

snippet.title: POV: You Need More Epi
snippet.description:
Sources- PMID 24041621 
BrickStreetMedical on TT 

An adrenaline autoinjector contains significantly more liquid medication than the single dose your body actually receives, typically delivering only about a quarter of its total volume when triggered. This extra reservoir is an intentional engineering feature designed to ensure the spring-loaded mechanism works reliably in an emergency. Having surplus fluid inside the cartridge helps maintain proper internal pressure so the device can push the exact prescribed dose deep into the muscle quickly and accurately, leaving the unused liquid safely behind in the barrel. Including extra adrenaline also plays a vital role in keeping the medication effective over time. Liquid adrenaline is chemically fragile and naturally breaks down when exposed to small amounts of oxygen, light, or temperature changes while sitting in a bag or cabinet. Starting with a larger volume of the drug acts as a protective buffer against gradual degradation, ensuring that a full, life-saving dose remains potent right up until the device's expiration date. 

#epipen #adrenaline #allergies

snippet.title: 🍌🍫 Skillet Banana Brownie 🤎
snippet.description:
🍌🍫 Skillet Banana Brownie 🤎

Soft, fudgy, naturally sweet, and made right in a pan — no flour, no oven needed! 😍

📌 Ingredients

🍌 2 ripe bananas
🥚 2 large eggs
🍫 40 g (⅓ cup) unsweetened cocoa powder
🍫 Dark chocolate chips or chopped chocolate, to taste

👩‍🍳 Preparation

1. Mash the bananas until smooth.
2. Add the eggs and cocoa powder, then mix until you have a smooth chocolate batter.
3. Stir in the chocolate chips.
4. Lightly grease a non-stick skillet and pour in the batter.
5. Cover with a lid and cook over medium-low heat for approximately 20 minutes, or until the brownie is set.
6. Let it cool slightly, slice, and enjoy! 🤎

Rich chocolate flavor, soft texture, and just four simple ingredients! 🍫✨

💖 Save this recipe for your next chocolate craving!
